gaps.explanation: p7 (printed p10) governmental funds statement: Transfers in General 416,325 + Street Repair and Maintenance 1,851,585 + Debt Service 71,814 = 2,339,724 (all in detail gross); the Reclassifications column prints (536,603) on Transfers in and +536,603 on Transfers out (intra-governmental transfers General 50,878 + Debt Service 20,992 + Special Grants 464,733 = 536,603), so the Total Governmental Funds column prints Transfers in 1,803,121 (the JSON statement figure). 2,339,724 - 536,603 = 1,803,121. Detail records the fund-column transfers gross; the statement total nets them. No fix.

Statement p10 (printed p14, Proprietary Funds modified cash basis, Total Proprietary column): total operating revenues 4,944,770 + interest and investment revenue 199,933 + grants 2,024 + insurance claims reimbursements 211,037 + employee benefit claim receipts (net of expense) 42,382 = 5,400,146. Detail is the ACCRUAL-basis Enterprise Fund combining schedule pp13-14 (printed pp47-48): total operating revenues 4,968,845 (charges for services 4,522,170 vs 4,498,095 on the statement) + 199,933 + 2,024 + employee benefit claims net of premiums 15,286 + insurance proceeds 211,037 = 5,397,125. Gap = (4,944,770 - 4,968,845) + (42,382 - 15,286) = -24,075 + 27,096 = 3,021. All schedule lines are already in detail; the two printed totals differ by basis. No fix.

Statement p10 (printed p14): total operating expenses 4,843,252 + debt issuance costs and trustee fees 85,900 + interest expense 147,292 = 5,076,444. Accrual-basis combining schedule p13 (printed p47) prints total operating expenses 4,814,811, plus p14 interest 147,292 and debt issuance 85,900 = 5,048,003. Differences: Insurance 160,094 (statement) vs 154,966 (schedule) = 5,128; Plant repairs, maintenance, and supplies 661,499 vs 638,186 = 23,313; 5,128 + 23,313 = 28,441 = gap. Every schedule line is in detail; the schedule is printed on the accrual basis. No fix.
